A floor bristling with nails entered my vision. Every last one stood with its sharpened point aimed upward.
我看见了铺满钉子的地面。无数的钉子，每颗都尖端向上。

There was no doubt they would skewer me if I kept falling straight toward them.
要是就这么掉下去的话，那些钉子毫无疑问会将我的身体完全贯穿……

I could do nothing but plummet helplessly, far more terrified of the pain and torture waiting below than of the impact of the fall itself.
比起下落的冲击，我还是对下方等待着的痛苦更为恐惧，但却只能束手无策地坠落下去。

But right that instant, I heard a voice.
然而就在那时，

<color=#4457b1>... Make for the sea, then...</color>
<color=#4457b1>如果是……前往大海的话……</color>

At the sound of that voice, the nail-strewn floor transformed into a vast sea, its blue surface rolling in gentle waves.
伴随着某人的声音，那片地面变为了碧波荡漾的广阔大海。

And when the waves of those fathomless waters finally surged up to meet me...
接着，在那片遥远海面的波浪迫近至我的面前时……

<color=#916e46>We extend our warmest welcome to the valued guests of Grand Magasin Sisyphe visiting today.</color>
<color=#916e46>今日也热烈欢迎各位客人光临西西弗百货。</color>

<color=#916e46>Grand Magasin Sisyphe is ever committed to cherishing every experience our customers procure within.</color>
<color=#916e46>西西弗百货，一直致力于珍惜客人们在此可获得的所有经验。</color>

<color=#916e46>To keep abreast of the latest fashions, we actively encourage the wide variety of shops available at the department store to open and close according to trends. Please take care not to lose your way as you explore the establishment.</color>
<color=#916e46>我们西西弗百货，总是根据潮流来推荐各类店铺的开张与闭店。请各位客人注意不要迷路。</color>

<color=#916e46>As always, restrooms on every floor are currently under repair. Please take note of this when planning your visit. We apologize for the inconvenience.</color>
<color=#916e46>一如既往，百货店内所有楼层的卫生间目前都处于维修状态中。由此带来的不便，请您谅解。</color>

<color=#916e46>To prevent hygiene issues, entry to each floor will be limited to customers who have achieved the required Prestige Tier. Please visit our Customer Service Center on the sixth floor for any further queries.</color>
<color=#916e46>为防止污染，目前仅限身份符合的客人可进入各楼层。如有任何疑问，请移步至6F客服中心。</color>

<color=#916e46>Customers are welcome to make physical contact with all Mannequins on display. Conversely, Mannequins are also allowed to make physical contact with all customers. Should you wish to participate, please talk to the sales associate at the relevant shop, who will be delighted to assist you.</color>
<color=#916e46>此外，我们允许自由触碰展出的人台。我们同样允许人台自由触碰各位，如果您咨询店员的话，他们会很乐意为您提供帮助。</color>

<color=#916e46>We ask everyone to do their best to ensure another day of worthwhile consumer experience for our customers. Thank you for choosing Grand Magasin Sisyphe, and enjoy your shopping.</color>
<color=#916e46>那么今天也请大家致力于为客人们提供有价值的购物体验。祝您购物愉快。</color>

What we experienced just now...
方才我们所经受的究竟是……

I just know it's something I never want to go through again... I mean, I've been killed in a variety of different ways on this team, but to be forced to face death when it wasn't even a combat situation... And on top of that, having to feel the sensation of doing it myself is just... a big no. 是我不想再经历第二次的东西。虽然我们确实经历过各种各样的死法，但这可是在非战斗的情况下……而且是凭自己的意志去死的感觉……呃呜。
Can't believe residents in N Corp. pay money to purchase that nasty experience. You couldn't pay me to go through that twice. N公司的人们竟然会花钱体验这些。就算有人拿钱砸我我也不会去的。

To package the very severing of life as amusement, then sell it as a product...
竟然将离世的体验包装成娱乐售卖……

Though conquering boredom is, forsooth, no simple feat, this is... hmm...
虽说克服无趣十分困难……嗯……

It felt more real than I imagined.
它比我想象中要真实得多。

I knew it was all taking place within a machine... Yet in that moment, I truly felt as though... I were witnessing the final moments of my life.
虽然我知道这是在机器中发生的事情……但那一瞬间真的……让我觉得这幅景象就是最后能看到的画面了。

When the noose tightened, I thought my neck was gonna snap...
我的脖子都被勒得快要断掉了……
I'm with Ishy... People actually pay money to put themselves through this? 大家为什么花钱也要体验这种东西呢？

There are those who, with no real purpose in mind, tie themselves to a cord and leap from great heights, or surrender themselves to violent waves to see whether or not they will be swept under.
有些人并没有什么特别的目的，只是想要体验系上绳子从高处落下的感觉，或是任凭身体在激流中漂荡，只为测试自己会不会掉下去。

It is said that people come to feel the sensation of being alive more keenly via experiences that bring them infinitely close to death.
据说在那些逼近死亡的体验之中，反而能感受到自己依旧活着。

... So ya sayin' they do it on purpose?
……所以他们是故意的？

Distasteful.
真让人不爽。

Silence prevailed as everyone reeled from the aftermath of the experience.
可能是大家还没能摆脱那场体验的余波，沉默持续了一段时间。

<Where are we anyway...?>
<话说回来，这里是……>

It was an unnecessary question, actually. The view that entered my sight told me in no uncertain terms what exactly this room's purpose was.
实际上，这句话没什么必要。因为这个地方太过显而易见了。

... It's a restroom.
……是卫生间。

Verily, 'tis a privy!
嗯，此乃卫生间。

A place where one's innermost troubles may be emptied.
确实是解忧所。

We went through all that shite in that bloody machine... just to get to a toilet?
不过是……为了去个卫生间，就非要用那台机器搞出这么大动静吗？

It's true Nelly's lies have put us in danger before, but it didn't appear to me that she was trying to harm or deceive us this time around...
虽然耐莉小姐的谎言曾让我们陷入了绝境……但这次感受不到她要那么做的理由或是迹象。

Fau. The machine we triggered... was it some kind of teleporter?
小浮，我们启动的那个东西……是什么空间传送的机器吗？

The verdict would differ depending on our interpretation of the experience, but it is certain that our bodies were not physically sent to this place. That shouldn't be an issue, however, as this is indeed the destination we were bound for, which we have reached successfully.
嗯……虽然这取决于怎么定义，但我们的身体并没有被传送至其他空间。不过这里就是我们的目的地，所以没有问题。

So... where the heck are we? Where do we go to find Meur?
所以……要去哪里才能见到默尔呢？

Rodya asked, completely lost.
罗佳困惑地问道。

As indicated by the announcement, this place is...
正如广播所说，这里是……

The Grand Magasin Sisyphe. We will be able to locate Meursault here.
西西弗百货，所以能在这里找到默尔索先生吧。

That's the factory that produces Canned Experiences, right...?
之前说过这里是生产经验罐头的工厂……对吧。

... That woman standing there might have more information about this place.
……那个人说不定知道更为详细的答案。

She looks similar... to Demian...
她和德米安……长得好像……

Identify yourself. What do you know about this place?
你是谁？关于这里你知道多少？

... This place...
……这里是……

The woman, with a benevolent smile gracing her lips, is watching us serenely.
一位面带慈爱微笑的女性正注视着我们。

The sight of her smile alone is enough to set me at ease.
光是看到那个微笑，就能感到内心逐渐平静下来。

... It is where everything that is washed away comes to rest. The "Fount"...
一切都被濯洗而去，顺流所抵达的场所……泉……

... That's not what we asked.
……我们问的不是这种问题。

Are you affiliated with this establishment? Can't deny there is something familiar about you.
你是这里的相关人员吗？虽然我并不能否认你的长相有些眼熟……

... All things appear... as one believes them to be.
……一切都只是……看上去如自己相信那般罢了。

Well, at least she doesn't seem hostile to us...
至少她对我们没有敌意……不过……

Do you happen to know what we're... supposed to do here...? Could you tell us if you do?
难道您恰好知道吗？我们在这里……该做些什么好……

... Demian, Rim, Sansón...
……德米安、林、参孙……

She gives off much the same impression as the three of them. Especially in how difficult it is to tell whether she is a friend or a foe.
她给人的印象和他们很像啊。尤其是不知是敌是友这一点。

Then again, those three did, in the end, prove helpful to us to some degree, despite their inscrutable intentions. Perhaps this one will be the same.
虽然依旧不清楚他们在想什么，但从结果来看他们帮了我们。这个人或许也是一样的吧。

Perhaps she had said all she meant to say, because she only gave a silent smile in return. The same benevolent smile she had given us earlier.
可能是话已经说完了，她只是沉默地微笑着。而那副微笑依旧满是慈爱。

Would it still be safe if we just... left through that door over there?
我们，那个……就这么出去可以吗？

... She still said nothing, but I thought I saw her inclining her head in affirmation ever so slightly.
……她虽然还是一言不发，但似乎微微点了点头。

<... Doesn't look like we got any other choice. Let's just head outside and see what's there.>
<……嗯，总之……先出去吧。>
